The FloPlast uPVC 112mm half round union bracket in black provides a robust and efficient solution for connecting gutter sections within roofline drainage systems. Constructed from durable PVCu, this union bracket is a practical and easy to install system. Its newly extended unions expertly manage expansion and contraction, ensuring secure and leak-free rainwater runoff. This guttering component is compatible with most major manufacturers and is ideal for both new build and essential refurbishment.
